title: Checks
description: Parts checks and robot checks per table, release of the rounds and round files.
noRounds: No round has games at tables yet.
releaseAnyway: Release although tables are not ready?
notReadyTables: Not ready yet: {tables}. Enter why the round is released anyway; the release is recorded in the audit log.

mode.label: Robot check
mode.hint: Synchronous: all tables check, then the head judge releases the round. Asynchronous: a team can be scored as soon as its check is confirmed. Fixed once the first check is recorded.

locked.not_confirmed: Confirm this team’s robot check first; the score sheet opens right after.

robot.queued: Checked on this device · sent when the connection is back
robot.confirmReady: One team is not checked yet. Mark the table ready anyway? | {count} teams are not checked yet. Mark the table ready anyway?
robot.partsOpen: The parts check “{title}” is not completed yet. The robot check of this round starts after it.
robot.synchronous: When every table is ready, the head judge releases the round for scoring.
robot.asynchronous: Each team can be scored as soon as its check is confirmed.
robot.released: The round is released for scoring.

parts.title: Parts checks
parts.blocksFirstRoundHint: Blocks the robot check and scoring of the day’s first round until completed
parts.confirmOpen: Not confirmed yet: {tables}. Complete the parts check anyway? This is recorded in the audit log.
